description: A guest house takes room bookings and handles check-in and check-out.
data: rooms with a room number (unique), a nightly rate and the most guests the room takes
bookings of a room with the guest's name, number of guests, check-in date, check-out date, the total price and a status (booked, checked in, checked out or cancelled)
actions: staff add rooms and change their rate
guests change the dates or number of guests of a booking
staff check guests in and out
rules: a room cannot be booked twice for the same nights
the group must fit in the room
check-out must be after check-in and bookings cannot start in the past
the total is the number of nights times the nightly rate
only a booking that has not started can be changed or cancelled
guests are checked in, then checked out
